Marking one year since the assassination of conservative activist Charlie Kirk, political commentators analyze the ideological shifts and internal power struggles within the MAGA movement.

The Poison:
Exploits a horrific act of political violence to fuel partisan division and smear political opponents.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing personal grief and loss (EMOTION) with geopolitical and factional maneuvering (POWER), attributing systemic policy shifts to individual absence.

Social Physics Analysis:
Factions run a Smart Selfish Maneuver: capitalizing on martyrdom to manufacture existential urgency, suppress internal debate, and project blame onto political rivals.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between memorialized ideals and partisan weaponization, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Exploiting assassination for political leverage guarantees escalating civic decay.

The Unavoidable Truth: Tragic political violence leaves lasting power vacuums that opportunistic factions rush to fill.

The Unavoidable Lie: The ideological direction of a national movement is dictated entirely by a single fallen personality.

They're really using a guy's murder to fight internal faction wars and score political points.
